news.title: Guenther and Sergachev each have goal and assist in Mammoth's 5-4 win over Maple Leafs
news.ruTitle: Гюнтер и Сергачев забили гол и сделали результативную передачу в победе Мамонта над Мэйпл Лифс со счетом 5:4.
news.description: — Dylan Guenther and Mikhail Sergachev each had a goal and an assist in the second period to help the Utah Mammoth beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 5-4 on Tuesday night.

news.title: William Karlsson has go-ahead goal and Golden Knights beat Predators 5-2 for 3-1 road record
news.ruTitle: Уильям Карлссон забил гол, и «Голден Найтс» обыграли «Предаторз» со счетом 5–2 и установили выездной рекорд 3–1.
news.description: — William Karlsson scored for the second straight game to put Vegas ahead, and the Golden Knights beat the Nashville Predators 5-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Martin Necas has 2 goals to lead the short-handed Avs past the Stars, 3-2
news.ruTitle: Мартин Некас забил 2 гола, чтобы вывести "Авс" в меньшинстве за пределы "Старз" со счетом 3-2.
news.description: — Martin Necas scored two goals, including a 5-on-3 score, and the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Dallas Stars 3-2 on Tuesday night in the opener of a home-and-home series.

news.title: Jets beat the Wild 5-2 as Cole Perfetti scores 2 goals
news.ruTitle: Джетс обыграли Уайлд со счетом 5:2, Коул Перфетти забил 2 гола
news.description: — Cole Perfetti scored a pair of goals, Mark Scheifele had a goal and two assists, and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Minnesota Wild 5-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Connor Bedard makes season debut, records assist in Blackhawks' win vs. Penguins
news.ruTitle: Коннор Бедард дебютирует в сезоне, рекордная результативная передача в победе «Блэкхокс» над «Пингвинз»
news.description: Teuvo Teravainen and Roman Kantserov scored two goals apiece, and the Blackhawks topped the Penguins 5-3 on Tuesday night in Connor Bedard's first game of the season.

news.title: Teuvo Teravainen helps the Blackhawks beat the Penguins 5-3 in Connor Bedard's season debut
news.ruTitle: Теуво Теравайнен помог "Блэкхокс" обыграть "Пингвинз" со счетом 5:3 в дебютном сезоне Коннора Бедарда
news.description: — Teuvo Teravainen and Roman Kantserov scored two goals apiece, and the Chicago Blackhawks topped the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-3 on Tuesday night in Connor Bedard's

news.title: Suter, Neighbours and McTavish score 2 each as the Blues rout the Senators 7-2
news.ruTitle: Сатер, Нейборс и Мактавиш забили по 2 гола, а «синие» разгромили сенаторов со счетом 7–2.
news.description: — Pius Suter, Jake Neighbours and Mason McTavish each had a pair of goals to lead the St. Louis Blues to a 7-2 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.

news.title: Kraken beat Flyers 3-2 in shootout as Philadelphia’s winless start reaches 8 games
news.ruTitle: «Кракен» обыграл «Флайерз» со счетом 3:2 в серии пенальти, а безвыигрышный старт «Филадельфии» достиг 8 игр
news.description: — Bobby McMann scored a goal in regulation and then added the game-winner in the fifth round of the shootout as the Seattle Kraken beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Kyle Palmieri scores twice as Islanders beat Canucks 3-2
news.ruTitle: Кайл Палмьери забивает дважды, когда «Айлендерс» обыграли «Кэнакс» со счетом 3–2
news.description: — Kyle Palmieri scored twice, Matias Maccelli added his first goal for New York and the Islanders beat the Vancouver Canucks 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Brady Tkachuk's natural hat trick helps Panthers end skid
news.ruTitle: Естественный хет-трик Брейди Ткачука помог «Пантерс» выйти из заноса
news.description: On the NHL's Frozen Frenzy night, the Tkachuk brothers fed right into it, as Brady Tkachuk had a natural hat trick and his brother Matthew Tkachuk matched a club record with five assists as the Florida Panthers beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 7-3 Tuesday.

news.title: Alexis Lafreniere scores twice as Rangers beat Lightning 4-1
news.ruTitle: Алексис Лафренье забивает дважды, когда «Рейнджерс» обыграли «Лайтнинг» со счетом 4–1
news.description: — Alexis Lafreniere scored twice and Dylan Garand made 25 saves as the New York Rangers beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-1 on Tuesday night for their fifth straight home win.

news.title: Zachary Bolduc scores decisive goal in shootout for 2nd straight game as Canadiens beat Sabres 4-3
news.ruTitle: Закари Болдук забивает решающий гол в серии пенальти во второй игре подряд, когда «Канадиенс» обыграли «Сэйбрз» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored the decisive goal in a shootout for the second straight game, and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 after blowing a two-goal lead Tuesday night.
